# Jyotika Spa, Thane

> Jyotika Spa is a contemporary boutique wellness sanctuary located at 1st Floor, Ashar Tiara Commercial Complex, Shop No. 14–17, Gandhi Nagar, Thane, Maharashtra 400601, India. We offer restorative full body massages, bespoke couple rituals, and holistic therapy in an unhurried, welcoming haven.
